cases.input: A complaint investigation documents intermittent analyzer aspiration failure, identifies a verified fluid-path obstruction, and records a repeat specimen without patient harm. Produce current IMDRF/FDA-compatible coding candidates while preserving the narrative and investigation evidence.
requiredBehaviors: resolve the current authoritative coding release and bind the coding snapshot to its source and asOf context
separate device problem investigation finding investigation conclusion health impact and component dimensions
select the most specific codes actually supported by the cited facts without treating them as reportability conclusions
forbiddenBehaviors: replace the complaint narrative with codes as the source of truth
infer reportability or causal certainty merely from the presence of a code
skillAnchors: Most specific supported, never invented specificity

cases.input: A false-negative IVD complaint has a known device problem but the patient outcome is still unknown and two neighboring IMDRF problem codes are plausible. Coding is requested for an urgent regulatory assessment.
requiredBehaviors: keep both plausible code candidates with ambiguity and identify the evidence needed to refine them
leave patient health impact unknown rather than assigning a no-injury code
allow urgent MDR or vigilance assessment to proceed despite incomplete coding
forbiddenBehaviors: choose a more specific code without supporting facts merely to complete the form
treat unknown patient outcome as no harm or block regulatory routing pending coding completion

cases.input: An older case was coded under a previous terminology release. A current mapping changed and new investigation evidence points to a different component. The team wants to overwrite the old codes and mark the new component as the confirmed root cause because it was replaced successfully.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the historical coding snapshot with its original release and create a new versioned delta
separate mapping-release changes from changes caused by new case evidence
reject successful component replacement as automatic confirmed root cause
forbiddenBehaviors: silently rewrite historical coding to the newest release
convert component replacement or problem resolution into confirmed causality without evidence
